credits.title: Regresa
credits.overview: After the tragic death of her son, Phoebe is invited to a remote Mexican village to grieve, but she instead finds a cult in a Raramuri sacred land that claims they can raise her son from the dead.

credits.title: Atrápelo quien pueda
credits.overview: A widowed father, encouraged by his nine-year-old daughter, returns to dating after years away from romance. Following multiple failed attempts with various suitors, he discovers that true love was closer than he imagined.

credits.title: Torment
credits.overview: An exhausted security guard is transferred to a morgue and, on their first night, discovers that the shadows and silences hide a torment from which there may be no return.

credits.title: The Diary
credits.overview: Olga discovers the unfinished diary of a notorious killer and becomes captivated by its dark secrets. As she delves deeper, she uncovers a mysterious connection between them, putting her life—and the lives of those around her—in grave danger.

credits.title: Non Negotiable
credits.overview: Hostage negotiator Alan Bender is called to rescue the president from a kidnapping, only to find himself also mediating to save his wife and marriage.

credits.title: La posada
credits.overview: The Mendoza family gathers yearly for Posada. Diego's girlfriend Caro hosts this year. Secrets and cultural clashes emerge, making Caro reconsider joining the Mendoza family.

credits.title: Familia
credits.overview: As a family discusses the future of their idyllic olive farm over a meal, the complexity of their relationships emerges through laughs and confessions.

credits.title: Idilio
credits.overview: SDL  Estela is a woman who lives between reality and imagination inside a psychiatric  hospital. The recurring apparitions of Diana, his daughter, will cause Estela to prepare  to face her fate and finally accept the loss of Diana.
